test_title: PYST 08: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 08 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3
solution:
The correct answer is '**meaningless**' (option 4).

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The passage discusses the necessity of morality for philosophy and religion to have substance and value.
 
• The word "meaningless" appropriately conveys the idea that without morality, philosophy and religion would lack significance.
 
• Other options ("**useful**,” "**popular**,” and "**rational**”) do not accurately convey the intended idea of lacking significance.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

Complete Passage: *We should remember that all religions (1) preach__ good conduct in life, the foundation of which should rest on (2) __ethics__. Without the basis of morality, philosophy would remain mere polemics, and religion would be (3) __meaningless__ and vain. Nobody can say that he is religious unless he is (4) __moral__ and unselfish. It is realised that by constant endeavour through thought, word and deed, one could (5) __achieve__ absolute peace of mind.* 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Useful**: This does not convey the idea of lacking significance.
 
• **Popular**: This does not fit the context of lacking significance or value.
 
• **Rational**: This does not fit the context of lacking significance or value.
